name: Bring the Heat AZ 2023
information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BringtheHeatAZ2023#31237-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

This competition is in partnership with [**Arizona Speedcubing**](https://www.arizonaspeedcubing.com)
